title: SAP dissectors: Harden dissectors against malformed packet lengths
description:
Tighten SAP protocol dissectors so truncated or inconsistent packet
lengths are handled as malformed input instead of driving unchecked
offsets, string scans, or oversized subtree lengths. Also consolidate
bit-flag display with proto_tree_add_bitmask() where the fields are
true flag groups.

packet-sapdiag.c:
- Convert request-info, support-bits, dynamic atom attribute, UI event,
  COM flag, and header flag fields to proto_tree_add_bitmask() arrays.
- Preserve existing flag names and bit positions while displaying flags
  through the standard bitmask subtree pattern.
- Add an early short-header guard before decoding the Diag header flags.

packet-sapenqueue.c:
- Add shared length validation for server-admin and connection-admin
  structures.
- Report malformed truncated admin headers, trace requests, parameter
  counts, parameter IDs, parameter lengths, and parameter values.
- Clamp variable trace pattern lengths to available packet data.

packet-saphdb.c:
- Bound authentication and GSS authentication field parsing by the
  containing part length.
- Add malformed expert info for truncated field counts, extended length
  headers, and field payloads.
- Limit segment and message loops to the advertised buffer bounds and
  captured remaining data.

packet-sapigs.c:
- Add captured-length checks around fixed ASCII fields and table metadata.
- Stop decoding incomplete headers and command bodies before fixed-width
  reads.
- Only add payload data when the declared length is fully available.

packet-sapms.c:
- Convert message-type flag groups to proto_tree_add_bitmask().
- Add short-header checks for MS, opcode, and ADM headers.
- Validate opcode body lengths, variable string lengths, IP-to-name
  payloads, logon fields, client fields, and null-terminated ACL entries.

packet-sapni.c:
- Clamp payload dissection length to the captured bytes available after
  the SAP NI header.
- Return the consumed header plus bounded payload length.

packet-saprfc.c:
- Reject packets shorter than the minimum RFC header.
- Add explicit APPC header length validation.
- Validate normal client/register TP header length before reading fixed
  address fields.

packet-saprouter.c:
- Replace unbounded tvb_strsize() use with bounded NUL searches.
- Validate eyecatcher, admin, route, error, and control message lengths.
- Bound route-string and error-string subdissection with subset tvbuffs.
- Use a 32-bit client count for trace requests and clamp client-ID item
  lengths to captured remaining data.

packet-sapsnc.c:
- Validate the fixed SNC header and minimum header length before reading
  fields.
- Convert QOP bit fields to proto_tree_add_bitmask().
- Clamp token and payload lengths to remaining captured data and report
  malformed length mismatches.

AI-Assisted: Codex (chat only)
